title: Workflows: Automate Tasks Without Writing Code | Orchard Core
description:
Sites often have to react to what happens on them: content is published, a user registers, a form is submitted. Doing that by hand is slow, and writing code for every case is costly.

The Workflows module lets you describe the reaction as a diagram in the admin. An event starts the workflow, tasks do the work, and Orchard Core keeps each run as an instance you can inspect.

In this video:
• Why workflows: reacting to what happens on a site
• The parts of a workflow: events, tasks, outcomes and transitions
• Enabling the Workflows feature
• Creating a workflow
• The designer: toolbar, activities, canvas and panels
• Building a workflow: an event, a task and a transition
• Running the workflow by publishing an article
• Following the instances of a workflow
• What else workflows can do: more events, more tasks, more control
